column1: # Global project gate. Only OPEN permits normal package selection.
# READONLY_REVIEW_AUTHORIZED permits only its exact Stage 2 report list.
# STAGE3_PRODUCT_ADMISSION_AUTHORIZED permits only the exact listed Stage 3
# product-admission report; DDL/DML still require separate SQL review.
# CLOSED_PENDING_NEXT_APPROVAL rejects all new selections until the user
# explicitly confirms the next independent package.

column5: Client-base Stage 3 product-admission review closed 2026-08-19: `mart.client_base_daily` has an approved SQL review, exact source controls and a seven-column contract. A separate user-approved DDL package is required before creation; initial load, refresh and Power BI reconciliation remain separate packages.
